oracle: only a folder's owner moves it to the Trash (A14.5b, SPEC §4)
what: trashFolder forgets its owner check (functions/src/lib/trash.ts), so a reader moves the owner's folder to the Trash

target.case: A14.5b Move… into a shared folder makes its readers the document's members, Move… out takes them away, a reader's folder menu cannot move it to the Trash, and trashing the folder takes the document out of their reach

expect.message: a reader may not move the folder to the Trash
